summary: CBSAR helped a group (reportedly including a U.S. Navy SEAL) cross the swollen East River at Rustler's Gulch; all crossed safely (article: 'everything turned out for the best')
notes: Date approximate: July 2011; the three missions occurred 'in just over a week' before the CBN feature (published July 2011); listed as first of month. Group size not stated in article; listed as 1 victim.
